html:
G'oya

Mijozning jami summasi bu GROUP BY customer_id bilan topiladigan narsa, lekin guruhlash buyurtmalarni bitta qatorga yig'ib yuboradi. Window funksiya qatorlarni joyida qoldiradi: SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) har bir buyurtma yoniga uning mijozi bo'yicha yig'indini yozadi.

Yechim

SELECT id, customer_id, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id) AS customer_total
FROM orders

Namunada 10-mijozning uchta buyurtmasi bor: 250, 400 va 50. Uchala qatorda ham customer_total 700 bo'ladi.

Tuzoqlar

OVER ichiga ORDER BY qo'shilsa, ma'no o'zgaradi: yig'indi guruh boshidan joriy qatorgacha hisoblanadi. 10-mijoz uchun 250, 650, 700 chiqadi, ya'ni o'sib boruvchi yig'indi. Bu masalada esa har qatorda to'liq jami kerak:

Noto'g'riSELECT id, customer_id, amount,
       SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY id) AS customer_total
FROM orders

PARTITION BY ni unutsangiz, OVER () butun jadvalni bitta guruh deb oladi va hamma qatorda barcha buyurtmalar summasi chiqadi.

Boshqa yo'l

Window funksiyalardan oldin buni hosila jadval bilan yozishardi: avval mijozlar bo'yicha yig'indi, keyin uni buyurtmalarga ulash.

SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, o.amount, t.total AS customer_total
FROM orders o
JOIN (
  SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total
  FROM orders
  GROUP BY customer_id
) t ON t.customer_id = o.customer_id
